The 20th Czech Days for European Research, Prague, CZ.

The [Oncobiome](https://www.oncobiome.eu) project was presented at the
[20th CZEDER](https://www.czeder.cz/), organized by the Technology Centre Prague.
At the meeting, Drs. Budinská and Popovici presented the project and some of
its most salient results, as well as other activities of
[RECETOX](https://recetox.muni.cz).
